Class TimedLocation

java.lang.Object
net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.schedule.TimedLocation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<TimedLocation>
Direct Known Subclasses:
WaveSynthSequencer.NoteTimedLocation
public class TimedLocation extends Object implements Comparable<TimedLocation>
Used to schedule or track events that take place at specific coordinate locations. Used in multiple example sketches.
